headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 26, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a thrilling 2-1 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Michael Busch leading the offense and Ben Brown pitching 6 strong innings for the Cubs. The Baltimore Orioles handed the Tampa Bay Rays a 7-9 loss, with Jonathan Aranda leading the Rays' offense and Shane McClanahan pitching 5.1 innings with 3 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. The Minnesota Twins fell short against the Chicago White Sox, with Anthony Kay earning the win for the White Sox. The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 5-1 loss to the Milwaukee Brewers, with Christian Yelich leading the Brewers' offense.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams, with several players landing on the injured list. The New York Mets transferred CF Luis Robert Jr. to the 60-day injured list due to a lumbar spine disc herniation. The Athletics placed RHP Aaron Civale on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder tendinitis and CF Denzel Clarke on the 60-day injured list with a mid foot bone bruise in his right foot. The Chicago White Sox placed LHP Noah Schultz on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 25, 2026, with right knee patellar tendinitis. The Milwaukee Brewers placed RHP Logan Henderson on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 23, 2026, with a low back strain. The Tampa Bay Rays placed RHP Jesse Scholtens on the 15-day injured list with a right wrist sprain, and the New York Mets placed CF Tyrone Taylor on the 10-day injured list with a right hip flexor strain. The Colorado Rockies placed LHP Jose Quintana on the 15-day injured list with a left elbow sprain.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including the Colorado Rockies trading LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash and the Philadelphia Phillies trading RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations and international bonus pool money. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley, and the Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Cubs in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Chicago Cubs 2-1, securing their win in a closely contested matchup. Michael Busch led the Pirates' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Ben Brown pitched 6 strong innings for the Cubs.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Orioles in Thrilling 7-9 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-9 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, handing the Rays their loss. Jonathan Aranda led the Rays' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs, while Shane McClanahan pitched 5.1 innings with 3 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall Short in South Side Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins dropped a 1-3 decision to the Chicago White Sox, unable to overcome a strong outing from Anthony Kay. Kay earned the win with 6.0 innings pitched, 5 strikeouts, and 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Brewers in 5-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals were defeated by the Milwaukee Brewers with a final score of 5-1. Christian Yelich led the Brewers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: New York Mets Injury Watch
top_news.summary: New York Mets logged a roster-health update involving Luis Robert Jr..

top_news.title: **Rockies Make Roster Move Ahead of Series**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies traded left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals in exchange for cash on May 25, 2026.
